definitions.explanation: Providing expert instruction or guidance, especially in traditional arts, martial arts, or specialized skills. Carries a nuance of mentorship and hands-on teaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{指南|しなん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{指南|しなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received direct instruction from the master.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{指南|しなん}{役|やく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えている→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: As a tea ceremony instructor, I teach etiquette to beginners.

notes:
Originally derived from the Chinese compass ({指南|しなん}{車|しゃ}), which points south — metaphorically meaning 'to show the correct direction.' The word has a classical, somewhat elevated tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指南|しなん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to instruct, to coach
- {指南|しなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive instruction
- {指南|しなん}{役|やく}: instructor, coaching role
- {指南|しなん}{書|しょ}: instruction manual, guidebook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: guidance, leadership — the standard modern term for instruction; broader in scope
- ⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧: teaching — formal instruction, especially academic
- コーチング: coaching — modern loanword for coaching methodology
- ⟦{師範|しはん}→師範：20595_shihan⟧: master instructor — a title for someone qualified to teach traditional arts
